usedFor: Leadsquared is a CRM, and “Create Lead” and “Create Activity on Lead” record who came in and what happened.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Lead” in Leadsquared
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message becomes a lead, so nobody waits to be typed in.

watchOut: “Create Activity on Lead” needs the lead to exist first, so run it after “Create Lead”.
